notes.title: 🗣️ Voices Update In my Skull 🎙️
notes.content: [p]The world of [i]Skull’s Impossible Quest[/i] just got a whole lot louder… and a whole lot more alive (well, undead). Every line of dialogue in the game now features fully voiced characters, bringing more personality, menace, and absurdity to your adventure![/p][h3][b]What’s New[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🎭 Fully Voiced Characters[/b] – All major characters now have unique, high-quality voice acting powered by our custom ElevenLabs voice design.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🦴 The Skull[/b] – Our fearless hero now speaks with a sharp wit, dry humor, and the occasional sarcastic jab at his foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]👹 Imp Companion[/b] – Your mischievous sidekick delivers fast-talking banter, impish taunts, and the occasional helpful tip (whether you want it or not).[/p][/*][*][p][b]🪦 The Council[/b] – Three eerie undead voices speaking in unison, offering cryptic advice… or thinly veiled threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🍖 Fatty Boss[/b] – Gluttony has a voice, and it’s loud, grotesque, and disturbingly proud of it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]👑 Skeleton King[/b] – A regal, commanding tone echoing through his ancient hall of pillars.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎩 Ghoul Boss[/b] – Smooth, sinister, and theatrical—like a haunted gentleman hosting your demise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]❄️ Zombie Viking Boss[/b] – Cold as the mountains he calls home, with the fury of an ancient war chief returned from the grave.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Why This Matters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Deeper immersion in the story[/p][/*][*][p]More memorable and distinct villains[/p][/*][*][p]Funnier, sharper banter between characters[/p][/*][*][p]Combat encounters that [i]sound[/i] as epic as they feel[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]How to Experience the New Voices[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Update your game to the latest version[/p][/*][*][p]Start a new adventure [b]or[/b] load your current save[/p][/*][*][p]Turn up the volume, and let the voices guide… or haunt you[/p][/*][/list]
